sloka: सुराः शृणुत मद्वाक्यं यत्तावन्मम रोचते ।जीवन्नेव दशग्रीवः साधु रक्षो निगृह्यताम् ।। ७.२९.१३ ॥
transliteration: surāḥ śṛṇuta madvākyaṁ yattāvanmama rocate ।jīvanneva daśagrīvaḥ sādhu rakṣo nigṛhyatām ।। 7.29.13 ॥

translations.english: O gods, listen to my words, which seem good to me: this demon Dashagriva should be captured alive.
